scope: historical evidence independently hash checked and metrics reconstructed; not new fits

original_protocol.split: per-bank chronological 50/20/30 percent; global non-overlap asserted
original_protocol.regularization: mean log loss plus lambda/2 times squared non-intercept coefficients
original_protocol.known_threshold: validation maximum F1, largest threshold on ties
original_protocol.novelty: raw amount high means unknown; validation 95th percentile

Context LR: log1p(1000 * prior client merchant count / (prior client events + 1))
log1p(1000 * prior client device count / (prior client events + 1))

original_protocol.history: prequential unlabeled history includes earlier validation/test events; excludes current and future events
original_protocol.seed_summary: mean and sample standard deviation ddof=1; no confidence intervals or significance claims
